title: Control Room Approval (v1)
description: The durable, broker-issued approval capability. The broker computes the digest (RFC 8785 / JCS canonicalization of the bound fields, then SHA-256); the agent references digest when claiming. Kept in lockstep with internal/policy/approval.go and checked by internal/protocol/schema_test.go.

plan_revision.description: Exact plan revision the approval is bound to. A stale revision cannot receive a new approval or claim.

digest.description: Prefixed SHA-256 digest binding protocol version, session ID, canonical plan revision, canonical selected actions, workspace identity, permission envelope, expiration, and max claims.

allowed_action_ids.description: The selected action IDs this approval covers, in the reviewed order. Must be non-empty and each ID unique.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 expiration timestamp. Claims at or after this instant fail closed.

max_claims.description: Maximum number of times this approval may be claimed. Single-use by default (1).
